day.headline: A Pig day — Rabbit and Goat are in step.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a hair day that decided itself
signs.message: Hair decided for itself and it's right. Get photographed today.

reasons: Rabbit and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Drop the ask in like it's nothing. That's the trick.

reasons: Pig's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: The week ended somewhere you didn't plan. Build tonight from there.

reasons: Snake opposes Pig — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Eleven minutes late is nothing. Walk in like you meant it.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the light you always leave on
signs.message: Flick off the one you always leave burning. Small, satisfying.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a ticket barrier that will not open
signs.message: Tap twice, then wave someone over. Don't argue with a turnstile.

reasons: Tiger pairs with Pig — a harmonious day
signs.motif: the necklace with a stiff clasp
signs.message: Ask the nearest person to fasten it. Ten seconds, done.

reasons: Goat and Pig share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the last one on the shelf
signs.message: Only one left and it's fine. Take it, stop deliberating.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the lid that no longer fits
signs.message: Nothing seals properly anymore. Plate on top, call it closed.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You already won it. Leave the last word on the table.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the good day you did not notice
signs.message: Turns out yesterday was good. Run it back, slower.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Two names on that thing. Let today be theirs.
